Class TesselDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
net.tessel.fx.components.TesselWindow
net.tessel.fx.components.TesselDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public class TesselDialog extends TesselWindow
A dialog window with the Tessel chrome (title bar, rounded frame, shadow) and no minimize or maximize button. Modal by default. 
TesselDialog dialog = new TesselDialog(window, "Rename file");
dialog.setContent(form);
dialog.showDialog();       // sizes to the content, centers on the owner, waits until it is closed
Esc and the title bar's close button fire a close request first, so a setOnCloseRequest handler can veto (by consuming the event); Stage.close() closes without asking.

For confirmations that should be drawn over the window itself, use ContentDialog.
